name: figbud-global-lp
description: FigBud Global corporate website and product ecosystem monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w figbud-web && npm run build -w zirahr-web
scripts.api:lint: cargo fmt --manifest-path services/api/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path services/api/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run api:lint && npm run api:test
